blockers.summary: GitHub Pages is disabled because t-hajongkim/test is private while the owning account is on the GitHub Free plan.
blockers.resolution_path: Make the repository public or upgrade to a plan that supports Pages for private repositories, then set Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source to GitHub Actions. actions/configure-pages cannot self-enable Pages with GITHUB_TOKEN because its enablement input requires a separate token with repository administration and Pages write access.
